statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low because the cash-session rally included meaningful retracement and NQ is in its daily maintenance break; Marvell's after-hours decline adds event stress but does not establish a persistent index path.
recommendation: Tail remains below the blocking threshold; the next path-quality checkpoint is the 22:00 UTC NQ reopen after Marvell's earnings reaction.
headline: Marvell reaction adds stress; NQ path unverified during maintenance
body: The Nasdaq closed 1.57% higher and Nvidia gained 8.7%. Marvell beat Q2 forecasts and guided above consensus, yet its shares fell nearly 3% after hours. CME's daily 17:00-18:00 ET maintenance leaves no live NQ path in this hour, so persistent no-retracement continuation is not verified.

lookbackSummary: Tail moved from low to WATCH during Nvidia repricing, peaked at 24% overnight and again before the U.S. open, fell to low after the cash open retraced, then returned to WATCH late in the session. The 06:00 UTC slot is unavailable because no snapshot was published.
outlookSummary: Marvell's after-hours reaction is being absorbed while NQ is in its daily maintenance break; the 22:00 UTC reopen is the immediate path-quality checkpoint. Friday's main risk concentration is the cash open through the 14:00 UTC Warsh/Michigan/CES cluster.

forecast.analysis: Post-reopen price discovery remains event-sensitive. Persistent sector-wide extension would keep Tail in WATCH, while balanced futures trade and meaningful retracement would reduce the one-way-path concern.
If Marvell-related repricing remains contained after the reopen, Tail falls back to low as U.S. after-hours liquidity thins. A delayed semiconductor second leg would invalidate that normalization.
Late U.S. evening conditions favor digestion rather than directional efficiency if cross-assets stay orderly. A fresh geopolitical or technology shock is the main conditional amplifier.
Early Asia risk is mainly residual. Without a new catalyst or sustained futures extension, the expected structure is more balanced than one-way.
The overnight baseline remains consolidation. Broader AI-sector follow-through combined with rising yields or volatility would weaken that assumption.
Tail stays low if the Nvidia-Marvell divergence is absorbed without a broad directional futures impulse. New geopolitical escalation would be a separate invalidation.
Pre-Europe conditions should remain relatively quiet if overnight futures hold a two-way range. Unusually persistent extension would be the key structural exception.
Europe's handoff can reintroduce direction. Tail remains low unless technology leadership broadens and pullbacks become consistently shallow.
European cash flows provide a global breadth check. Mixed regional participation would argue against a persistent one-way Nasdaq path.
Mid-European trade remains a cross-asset checkpoint. An aligned rise in yields, volatility and technology futures would raise concern; conflict among them would favor mixed conditions.
As U.S. premarket participation builds, the prior Nvidia-led rally can be retested. Tail stays low unless premarket extension becomes unusually efficient with weak retracement.
U.S. premarket liquidity increases ahead of Friday's policy/data cluster. Directional continuation is conditional on broad participation and shallow pullbacks rather than the scheduled events alone.
With the cash open approaching and Chicago PMI/14:00 UTC releases ahead, Tail moves to WATCH conditionally. Event importance raises Stress; a block still requires observed one-way price structure.
The U.S. cash open and 13:45 UTC Chicago PMI create a price-discovery window. Tail remains WATCH unless opening continuation shows repeated extension after weak or failed retracements.
Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote, final Michigan sentiment and CES benchmark releases converge at 14:00 UTC. Stress is extreme, while Tail remains WATCH pending the observed post-release path.
The first post-event hour is a delayed-repricing checkpoint. Sustained directional efficiency with failed retracements would keep Tail at the top of WATCH; orderly two-way discovery would lower it.
Event risk should begin to decay if rates and equities stabilize. Tail remains WATCH while any delayed policy repricing is unresolved, but two-way trade would support normalization.
By late morning U.S. time, a stable rates response and meaningful equity retracements would reduce Tail; renewed broad technology extension would keep WATCH conditions in place.
If post-event price discovery is orderly, Tail returns to low as the session matures. A fresh directional rates move or geopolitical shock would be the main conditional amplifier.
Early afternoon conditions favor normalization if breadth is balanced and volatility remains contained. Persistent session-extreme holding would invalidate that assumption.
Power-hour risk rises conditionally if the session is already trending and pullbacks have repeatedly failed. Without that observed structure, the higher Tail estimate remains only a scenario.
Cash-close risk stays in WATCH conditionally because late policy repricing can extend into settlement. A balanced close with meaningful retracement would reduce the next-session carryover concern.

forecastDetail.comment: Marvell's negative after-hours reaction raises event stress, but NQ is in maintenance and the cash session included meaningful retracement.
The NQ reopen is the first direct path-quality test; sustained extension with shallow pullbacks would keep WATCH active.
Post-reopen Tail remains conditional on broad semiconductor follow-through and failed retracements; two-way trade would reduce concern.
Contained post-event trading would return Tail to low; a delayed semiconductor second leg would invalidate normalization.
Late U.S. evening risk should fade if cross-assets stay orderly and no fresh catalyst develops.
Early Asia remains a residual-risk window; absent sustained futures extension, balanced structure is the base case.
